aggregation.rule: any required gate SKIPPED -> ESCALATE; then any FAIL -> FAIL; elif any ESCALATE -> ESCALATE; elif no required gate -> ESCALATE; else (all required PASS, optional SKIPPED policy-valid) -> PASS

observations.rule: all runs identical (exit_code+output_sha256) -> PASS; else FAIL
